method: initialize + tools/list (anonymous, no tool called; roadmap#992)

tools.name: uxcam_list_resources
tools.description:
List available UXCam MCP resource URIs.

Args:
  prefix: Optional **URI** prefix filter (e.g., "mcp://uxcam/docs/android/latest/").
          Do NOT pass keywords like "installation" — use
          uxcam_search_resources(query="installation") instead.

Returns:
  {
    "uris": [ ... ],
    "count": <int>,
    "total": <int>,
    "prefix": "<prefix or empty>",
    # When keyword misuse is detected:
    "hint": "<how to use search>",
    "top_matches": [ {"uri": str, "title": str, "score": int} ]
  }

tools.name: uxcam_read_resource
tools.description:
Read a UXCam MCP resource by URI and return content with metadata.

Args:
    uri: mcp://uxcam/... URI
    include_code_blocks: Include extracted code blocks (if available).
    max_chars: Truncate returned text to this many chars (optional)
    with_metadata: Include metadata gathered from frontmatter/file.
    include_frontmatter: Keep YAML frontmatter in the returned text.
        Set False to strip it for token-efficient LLM consumption.

Returns:
    {
      "uri": str,
      "mimeType": str,
      "text": str,
      "metadata": dict?,
      "code_blocks": [ {content, language, title, ...} ]?
    }

tools.name: uxcam_search_resources
tools.description:
Naive-but-robust search across resources with synonyms and ranking.

Args:
  query: free text, e.g. "installation" or "screen analytics"
  platform: optional ("android" | "ios" | "react-native" | "flutter" | "web")
  phase: optional, ignored but kept for back-compat
  scope_prefix: optional URI prefix; if absent and platform is set,
                defaults to f"mcp://uxcam/docs/{platform}/"
  limit/offset: pagination

Returns:
  {
    "matches": [ {"uri": str, "title": str, "score": int} ],
    "count": <int>,        # number returned
    "total": <int>,        # total available (after scoring)
    "scope_prefix": "<prefix or empty>",
    "query": "<original>",
    "slug_used": "<canonical or empty>"
  }
